operator_notes: Bulletin is a real PDF at /pdf/DDMMYY.pdf (e.g. 020826.pdf = 02/08/2026).
Download step keeps a dated example URL; harvester rewrites DDMMYY each Sunday.
Do not set use_captured_url on the download step — that freezes the trained week forever.
Start from news.html so harvest does not download the example PDF before rewrite.
Ardmore weekly bulletins are normally ~9 pages — max_bulletin_pages=12 allows them.
do_not: Do not set use_captured_url: true on dated /pdf/DDMMYY.pdf recipes.
Do not use use_page_url only — GitHub cannot read Chrome's internal PDF viewer address.
Do not worry if Document Properties title mentions Microsoft Word.
